permission: Separate explicit scientific chat execution permission required. No proof/certificate/saved approval text/new grant.

policy.U: exact original stored bytes; no polar/codec
policy.variable: upper triangular tail J only, unconstrained sign

scientific_question: Can one newly permitted LP with the native minimum small-entry cutoff qualify against unchanged ORIGINAL full-row primal/dual/gap/guard gates, then preserve tail tensor and operator? H4 correction and improvement are not assumed.

mathematics.j: 6 frames *10 frame-major upper triangular entries, signed/unbounded
mathematics.A: 256 original real tensor entries x60; off diagonal J contributes BOTH dyads; b=existing independent contraction(j0)
mathematics.T: 216 nonidentity I/Z/ZZ Pauli coefficients x60, existing spin expansion; exact L1 without smoothing/entrywise J substitution
mathematics.initial_feasibility: original j0 is feasible in ideal algebra; verify full-row numerical residual before interpretation
mathematics.no_constraint_reduction: No SVD truncation, approximate nullspace constraints, polar projection, PSD, rank-one, frame reordering or new U.
mathematics.rank: 8 stored frames retained including possible zero coefficient matrices; no frame elimination/rank exploration
mathematics.uniform_shift: artificial reference only; no additional molecular LP execution

numerical_policy.equality: maxabs(Aj-b)<=1e-10+1e-10*maxabs(b); independent contraction gate max entry<=1e-10
numerical_policy.conditioning: report all singular values; cutoff eps64*max(A.shape)*sigma_max is diagnostic ONLY; retained condition<=1e12 for numerical qualification
numerical_policy.precision: binary64 numerical pilot; not a validated feasibility, dual lower bound, exact nullspace or global mathematical certificate; no post hoc tolerance changes
numerical_policy.DF: saved guard-inclusive DF bound + ||Hnew-Hold||sector,2 + drift_guard <=0.00019875 Ha

checks.U_head: original U all entries/bytes and J head0/1 unchanged; original g-corrected kappa/scalar/frame order
checks.tensor: existing independent ffsim-compatible contraction of full tail before/after
checks.operator: new sector36 raw six frames vs independent general-K; old/new full256 six-frame sums plus full/sector mapping
checks.phase: tail identity coefficient old/new within1e-10; no phase fit
checks.PF_RTE: new one h-step partial PF/corrected K0 kernel versus immutable saved old sector36 kernels, absolute1e-10

checks.attenuation: one ideal-K0 profile of13rounds using existing normalization; zeros use deterministic path and A=1; no shots calculation

candidate.identity: new exported NPZ SHA256 plus parent saved export and fixed LP SOURCE; generated only after permitted execution
candidate.qualification: not adopted until LP numerical qualification and all registered preservation gates PASS; old optimizer remains UNQUALIFIED

results.correctness_FAIL: tensor/identity/operator/PF/RTE/DF-budget/input mismatch =>failed STOP, partial evidence; not success even if lambda decreases

resource_policy: No CPU/RAM/worker/wall cap or explicit iteration/time solver cap. H4 dense A is small; existing dynamic resource_plan(12,128) for full CAR frames with process-local BLAS coordination; probe actual resources. No shared environment/cache/process changes.
exclusions: repairing duals or dropping constraints to make returned point pass
rewriting original consumed run01 or transferring its unused41 units

STOP.correctness: Stop dependent calls at first mismatch, cancel queued tasks and safely drain started work; preserve raw/source/journal/failure/STOP
STOP.solver: Unqualified LP is unresolved, not proof that improvement is absent. Do not restart solver, fallback to original, or add an arm.
STOP.preservation: Improved objective without all preservation gates is not algorithm success.
STOP.completion: Commit/push/remote/source/raw verification then mandatory STOP; no new scientific stage
STOP.option_handling: Unexpected option warning pattern =>correctness/technical STOP after raw export; no solver retry or default fallback

parent_stopped_execution.reuse: Parent bytes and STOP remain immutable. No resume, budget transfer or adoption of parent raw x.

numerical_change.rationale: Native supported minimum; avoid default deletion of small nonzero matrix entries. Fixed before any new H4 decode/run.
numerical_change.data: Original A, T, independent-contraction b, j0, signed variables, all256 equality rows and432 inequalities unchanged.
numerical_change.native_limit: HiGHS may still treat |entry|<=1e-12 as zero and perform internal presolve. No exact full-real LP guarantee; qualification always uses original unmodified matrices.

expected_messages: Unrecognized options detected: {'small_matrix_value': 1e-12}. These will be passed to HiGHS verbatim.

warning_handling.reason: SciPy1.14.1 integer-loop duplication warns once for a float; subsequent double setter applies it. Artificial sentinel distinguishes1e-12 from1e-11/default.
warning_handling.rule: Save every warning verbatim; exactly these two occurrences allowed. Additional/missing/different warnings stop at LP_diagnose after raw LP export. No generic suppression or fallback.
